svg.title: At 248 K, similar CLOUD formation rates admit different chemical pathways
svg.desc: At 248.3 K, 0.38 pptv ammonia and 1.80 × 10⁷ sulfuric acid molecules cm⁻³, both models’ 90% scenario intervals for the formation rate overlap. The diamond marks the archived 0.030 particles per cubic centimetre per second.
